title: Retain immutable legacy run metadata without reviving execution gates
preconditions: A disposable legacy fixture has a case, implementation evidence and an existing run head; no command is executed from metadata.

steps.action: Read the explicit history query for the fixture with a legacy passed run.
steps.expected_result: The history output contains legacy_runs and its passed result literal.

steps.action: Compare archived public history records with the originally authored run values.
steps.expected_result: Identity, revision, result literal, summary, command text, execution time, source identity, parent heads and evidence references remain exact historical metadata.

expected_result: Retain immutable legacy run metadata without reviving execution gates.
